title: Geizhals Product & Offers Scraper
description: Get a Geizhals product record with manufacturer, current merchant offers, price summaries, categories, ratings, and review links. Batch product IDs to compare catalog entries.

batch.title: Product IDs
batch.description: Geizhals product IDs from product links or search results.
batch.valueDescription: Geizhals product identifier used for this lookup.

schema.description: Known Geizhals product id from product URLs such as ...-a2194110.html or a search gzhid.
Market code: de, at, eu, pl, or uk. Defaults to de.
Response language: de or en. Defaults to de.
Maximum number of merchant offers to include (1-100). Defaults to 20.
Include merchant/shop details on offers. Defaults to true.
Include test reviews and review details. Defaults to true.
Include product videos. Defaults to true.

storeCopy.seoTitle: Geizhals Product Scraper | Offers and Reviews
storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Geizhals product details by ID, including manufacturer, current offers, price summaries, ratings, and review links. Batch products for comparison.
storeCopy.intro: Look up Geizhals products by ID and retrieve the product record, merchant offers, category, price summary, and rating details. Add several IDs to inspect catalog items together.
useCases: Catalog managers can check manufacturer details and available merchant offers.
Pricing analysts can compare current best prices with product rating summaries.
Shopping teams can enrich product lists with Geizhals links and identifiers.
howToUse: Add one Geizhals product ID to `product_ids` per lookup.
Choose the market and language, then set how many offers and details to include.
Set `maxResults` and export one full product record per ID.

faqs.question: Does each row contain merchant offers?
faqs.answer: Yes. The product object includes the source offer list when offers are available; set the offer limit to control how many are requested.

fields.name: success
fields.description: True when the Geizhals request returned a successful response.

fields.name: product_id
fields.description: Numeric identifier for this Geizhals product record.

fields.name: loc
fields.description: Geizhals locale code used to select the product page language and market.

fields.name: lang
fields.description: Language code of the returned Geizhals product record.

fields.name: product
fields.description: Geizhals product details, including manufacturer, categories, price summary, offers, and product links.

fields.name: meta
fields.description: Response metadata from Geizhals, such as request duration and endpoint family.

fields.name: product_name
fields.description: Full Geizhals product name, including model and capacity.

fields.name: manufacturer
fields.description: Manufacturer name associated with this Geizhals product.

fields.name: best_price
fields.description: Best price amount for this product record; currency follows the selected source market.

fields.name: offer_count
fields.description: Number of offer records reported for this product record.

fields.name: product_url
fields.description: Public Geizhals URL for the product record or linked resource.

fields.name: input_product_id
fields.description: Product id submitted to retrieve this product record.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this dataset record was collected.
